title: Slack signature check always fails because the framework already parsed the body
symptoms: Invalid request signature on every request from Slack
Signature matches in a unit test but not behind Express json() or body-parser
Requests rejected after the server clock drifts
cause: The HMAC is computed over v0:timestamp:raw body, so a body that was parsed and serialized again no longer matches byte for byte. Requests whose X-Slack-Request-Timestamp is more than five minutes from local time must be rejected.
fix: Capture the raw body before any parser runs, compare with a constant-time function, and keep the server clock in sync with NTP.
affected: Slack HTTP request verification with signing secret v0, all versions as of 2026-10
